nodes.label: BertModel
nodes.desc: Assembles embeddings, attention mask, encoder stack, and pooler into one graph.

nodes.label: BertConfig
nodes.desc: JSON-loaded hyperparameters: 12 layers, 768 hidden, 12 heads for BERT-Base.

nodes.label: embedding_lookup
nodes.desc: Maps WordPiece ids to dense vectors, with TPU-friendly one-hot option.

nodes.label: embedding_postprocessor
nodes.desc: Adds learned position and segment embeddings, then LayerNorm and dropout.

nodes.label: create_attention_mask
nodes.desc: Expands the 2D padding mask into a 3D additive attention bias.

nodes.label: transformer_model
nodes.desc: Runs num_hidden_layers rounds of attention plus a position-wise FFN.

nodes.label: attention_layer
nodes.desc: Multi-head scaled dot-product self-attention with per-head splits.

nodes.label: gelu
nodes.desc: Gaussian Error Linear Unit used as the FFN activation.

nodes.label: get_pooled_output
nodes.desc: Returns the tanh-pooled [CLS] hidden state for segment-level tasks.

nodes.label: FullTokenizer
nodes.desc: Chains BasicTokenizer then WordpieceTokenizer and maps tokens to ids.

nodes.label: BasicTokenizer
nodes.desc: Cleans text: lower-casing, CJK char splitting, punctuation splitting.

nodes.label: WordpieceTokenizer
nodes.desc: Greedy longest-match-first segmentation into ##-prefixed subwords.

nodes.label: load_vocab
nodes.desc: Reads vocab.txt into an ordered token-to-index dictionary.

nodes.label: convert_tokens_to_ids
nodes.desc: Looks each token up in the vocab to produce integer input ids.

nodes.label: run_classifier.main
nodes.desc: Parses flags, picks a GLUE DataProcessor, and drives TPUEstimator.

nodes.label: DataProcessor
nodes.desc: Base class for GLUE tasks; subclasses yield InputExample sets.

nodes.label: InputFeatures
nodes.desc: Fixed-length record: input_ids, input_mask, segment_ids, label_id.

nodes.label: convert_single_example
nodes.desc: Tokenizes one example and truncates the pair to max_seq_length.

nodes.label: file_based_convert
nodes.desc: Serializes features into a TFRecord file of tf.train.Example protos.

nodes.label: file_based_input_fn
nodes.desc: Estimator input_fn that parses the TFRecord dataset back into tensors.

nodes.label: create_model
nodes.desc: Pooled output plus a softmax classification head and cross-entropy loss.

nodes.label: model_fn_builder
nodes.desc: Closure for TPUEstimator: builds model, loss, and training op per mode.

nodes.label: run_squad.main
nodes.desc: Orchestrates SQuAD reading, windowing, training, and prediction.

nodes.label: read_squad_examples
nodes.desc: Parses the SQuAD JSON into char-aligned document token spans.

nodes.label: convert_examples_to_features
nodes.desc: Slides a doc_stride window over long passages, marking answer spans.

nodes.label: create_model (SQuAD)
nodes.desc: Two softmax heads over start and end positions of the answer span.

nodes.label: model_fn_builder (SQuAD)
nodes.desc: Estimator closure combining the span model with the shared optimizer.

nodes.label: write_predictions
nodes.desc: Joins logits with features back into n-best answer strings.

nodes.label: get_final_text
nodes.desc: Realigns WordPiece predictions to the original whitespace text.

nodes.label: create_optimizer
nodes.desc: Polynomial decay with linear warmup, grad clipping at global norm 1.0.

nodes.label: AdamWeightDecayOptimizer
nodes.desc: Decoupled-weight-decay Adam; skips LayerNorm kernels and biases.

nodes.label: extract_features.main
nodes.desc: Loads a checkpoint and writes selected layer embeddings to JSON.

nodes.label: create_pretraining_data.main
nodes.desc: Masks 15% of tokens and pairs sentences for the two pretraining losses.

nodes.label: run_pretraining.main
nodes.desc: Pretrains BertModel with masked-LM plus next-sentence-prediction loss.
